offline_science_verification.comparison_rule: every formal sample is compared with the timing repeat 0 of the same combination through the unchanged comparator; the four timing repeat 0 samples are first qualified against themselves (metadata, roles, registered files), then 16 timing repeats 1..4 and 12 independent memory repeats 0..2 are compared with that same repeat 0
offline_science_verification.per_sample_artifact_checks: every comparison independently verifies the sample metadata, roles, registered files and artifact SHA receipts

readiness.metric: actual available physical memory at execution time
readiness.on_unmet: status=resource_not_ready; no comparison starts; the plan stays incomplete; wait for resources; never close user processes

memory_projection.level: assumption scene only; not causal, not a bound, not a guarantee

acceptance.noise_gate_rule: each of the four combinations must have relative MAD <= 5%; equality passes; this is the only noise criterion for the frozen measurement
acceptance.noise_gate_on_exceed: status=inconclusive (noise/resource), keep every sample; never claim product failure or phase pass
acceptance.future_candidate_rule_reserved: a >=5% gain in at least 4 of 5 pairs with all other combinations <=5% is reserved for comparing a future optimization candidate; it is not applied to the frozen baseline measurement
acceptance.science_rule: frozen comparator semantics unchanged: REL_TOL 1e-9, zero-tolerance for counts, 12 significant digits, full tuple multisets, task-level events binding 2000

stop_conditions: a timing combination exceeds the 5% relative MAD gate: keep every sample, classify the result as inconclusive, stop, no reruns or outlier removal, do not call it a product failure or a phase pass
an offline comparison returns status=fail: keep outputs and child logs, stop, do not change templates/seeds/tolerances/N
available physical memory is below 6 GiB when offline verification would start: report resource_not_ready and wait without closing user processes
any backend sample exits non-zero or fails registered-file/hash/PID identity checks: stop and preserve evidence
any temptation to modify the frozen contract, old batches, product code or comparator file: stop and report instead
